messages.plaintextBody:
James — good draft. I've marked it up (v2 redline attached). Two main points: (1) plead the alternative contractual interest claim at 4% over base as well as s.35A; and (2) add the express averment that the losses are direct losses arising naturally from the breach and outside any exclusion — it sets up our clause 11 argument. Otherwise happy. Let's get it to Harriet to settle.

Sarah
